sourceOfTruth: portable Agent Plugins package at the repository root (plugin.json, mcp.json, skills/people-finder/SKILL.md, bin/people-finder, src/people_finder). Generated adapters are pointers to that canonical source and contain no duplicated policy, tools or discovery logic.

hostData.reason: people-finder persists no state: it reads caller-named inputs and writes only the caller-named output path. No data directory is declared, so no store is fabricated on its behalf and no host state can be read through it.

hermes.verifiedBy: real isolated launch: the rendered adapter was loaded in a temporary HERMES_HOME and `hermes mcp test people-finder` connected to the bundled runtime and discovered its three tools (compile_people_queries, rank_people_candidates, start_people_research); the staged skill was simultaneously discovered by `hermes skills list` in the same isolated home. No real user profile was read or written.
hermes.notes: verified by the packaging probe's isolated launch; the adapter passes no data directory because the plugin stores nothing.

unverifiedClients.note: Clients without a proven isolated launch are absent from `clients` rather than labelled supported. A client that implements Agent Plugins reads the canonical fixed locations directly; a client that needs a rendered pointer gets one only after a real isolated launch proves it.

verification.method: isolated temporary host configuration only: a fresh temporary HERMES_HOME is rendered, the real host binary is invoked against it, and the real user profile is never read or written.
verification.never: nothing here implies people-finder performs search, identity resolution, contactability checks, sending, applying or any other external action; a candidate output is never proof of contactability.
verification.paths: no absolute user path is required by the package: adapters are rendered at probe time into a temporary location.

versionPolicy: a client entry claims verified only from a real isolated launch; availability of a binary is not integration proof.
